label: SEOUL GUIDE
title: How Korea makes 'functional cosmetics'
dek: A Korean label that means a claim was reviewed.

points.t: Products for brightening, wrinkles, sun protection and some other claims are reviewed in Korea.
Look for 기능성화장품 printed on the box.
It shows the claim was checked, not just marketing words.
It is a useful signal when comparing Korean formulas.
